[[Mt. Mortar]] }} '''Absolutely Azumarill''' (Japanese: '''VS マリルリ''' ''VS {{tt|Marilli|Azumarill}}''), titled '''Catch That Azumarill!''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 133rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 43rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} On {{rt|42|Johto}} {{adv|Crystal}} is still trying to capture the {{p|Psyduck}}. She decides to look at her [[Pokédex]], only to discover that is broken. Meanwhile, the Psyduck sneaks into a river and gets away. Suddenly, Crystal thinks of trying to catch other Pokémon, such as a {{p|Weedle}}, {{p|Caterpie}}, and {{p|Hoppip}}, and failing. She realizes that when she fell from the [[Bell Tower|Tin Tower]], her Pokédex broke. Since it is broken, the tracking system doesn't work, so she can't find {{p|Suicune}}. She remembers when she started to train. Her only Pokémon was {{p|Smoochum|Chumee}}. One day while practicing throwing [[Poké Ball]]s at a target, and not doing so well with her aim, a {{pkmn2|wild}} [[Archy|Arcanine]] appeared and chased her. She tripped and broke her arms, then fainted. The flashback ends and Crystal says that she might not be able to complete the Pokédex like this. And she can't call {{adv|Professor Oak}} because her [[Pokégear]] is broken too. Suddenly, a wild {{p|Azumarill}} appears and runs past with her [[Mirei|mother]] in pursuit. Her mother is ecstatic at seeing her daughter and says hello to Crystal's Pokémon. She notices the new member of Crystal's party and asks what {{p|Chikorita}}'s name is. Crystal introduces her to [[Megaree]] and her mother reveals that she taught Crystal to put "ee" at the end of her Pokémon's nicknames. She gives Crystal Poké Balls made by [[Kurt]] and asks her to catch the Azumarill. Crystal tries, but the Poké Ball bounces off the Azumarill, which sinks below the surface of the pond. Crystal tells her mother about what's happening to her, Suicune, and her mission to complete the Pokédex. Her mother tells her to go back to the place where she started training after {{tt|yelling at her|VIZ Media}}/{{tt|slapping her|Chuang Yi}}. Later, Crystal is at [[Mt. Mortar]]. She ties up her arms and begins to train again, while a {{p|Larvitar}} watches her. ==Major events== * {{adv|Crystal}} fails to capture more Pokémon. * Crystal starts to retrain on [[Mt.
